name: nvim
description: Private Codex plugin for Neovim issue investigation, worktree, and verification workflows.

interface.longDescription: Private Neovim issue workflow for Codex sessions: fetch GitHub issue context with gh, create isolated upstream worktrees, run parallel history and reproduction investigation, write a cross-session issue wiki, and stop before solutions or commits.
defaultPrompt: Investigate Neovim issue #12345 without proposing fixes
Create a Neovim issue worktree and write the report
